children.name: Cynomorium coccineum L.
children.description: Note: Jafri (in Ali & Jafri, Fl. Libya 17: 2. 1977) indicated 1084.1 (LINN) as type, but this collection lacks the relevant Species Plantarum number (i. e. " 1 ") and was a post- 1753 addition to the herbarium, and is not original material for the name.
